firm_data.firm_description: Slarskey LLC is a New York-based litigation boutique focused on high-stakes, high-impact disputes for clients ranging from emerging companies to global institutions. The firm is highly regarded for its work in commercial litigation and alternative dispute resolution.
notable_facts: The firm has a thriving plaintiff-side class action practice
The firm emphasizes that litigation can be an asset that adds value rather than an expensive burden

email.subject: AI for Slarskey LLC, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Emma,

Slarskey's plaintiff-side class action practice requires precision work at scale, and I suspect your 18-person team feels the pressure to compete on document review and case analysis without the overhead of BigLaw.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for litigation boutiques facing exactly those demands. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in New York to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw on their own terms.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
